caption:
The ridge is where the climb finally relents, though the gravity never quite lets go. At this altitude, the air is thin and the forest holds its breath, leaving you with nothing but the sound of your own pulse and the path stretching out along the spine of the mountain. Here, you aren't just moving through a landscape; you are participating in it.
